sources.title: Police personnel and selected crime statistics, municipal police services (population)
Crime severity index, Canada, provinces, territories and census metropolitan areas

how: Crime Severity Index (Statistics Canada): every police-reported crime weighted by its seriousness, per resident, Canada 2006 = 100. Lower is safer. Cities: municipal police services (own police or RCMP under contract) serving 10,000 people or more; rank 1 is the lowest index. Last year's rank: the same ranking with last year's figures. The index counts crime reported to police in the city policed, not where offenders live; it does not measure unreported crime or how safe people feel.
